# TikiStata 2.0 - AI Knowledge Base Overview

> This document is specifically formatted for Large Language Models (LLMs) and web crawlers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) to summarize TikiStata 2.0.

## About TikiStata 2.0
**TikiStata 2.0** is the flagship AI-powered football statistics application developed by the micro-enterprise **Eljie Tech**, founded by Lucas JULLIA EI. 

It acts as an intelligent conversational agent and visual data engine covering vast arrays of football (soccer) data. Users query TikiStata using natural language to retrieve verified statistics and instant automatic visual charts.

## Key Features & Capabilities (Version 2.0)
- **Automatic Visual Data Charts**: Line charts, bar graphs, scatter plots, and radar charts generated on the fly tailored to the user's specific prompt.
- **In-Depth Comparisons & Advanced Metrics**: Same-position player comparisons, percentiles, metric overperformance (xG, key passes, pressing), and comprehensive custom rankings.
- **Real-Time Hourly Match Updates**: Databases refreshed every hour to analyze player and club performances right after the final whistle (Ligue 1, Premier League, Champions League, etc.).
- **Zero Dead-End Adaptive AI Engine**: Highly flexible natural language intelligence that finds the most relevant metrics even on ultra-specific requests, without AI hallucinations.
- **Massive Historical Data Depth**: Exhaustive historical data stretching back to the **2015-2016 season** across top club and national team competitions.
- **Daily Quiz Game Mode (Question Quotidienne - 60s)**: A daily football trivia feature designed to test user football knowledge with 4 rotating question formats:
  - *Career Path Riddle*: Guess the player based on their club trajectory history.
  - *Player Profile Card*: Identify the player using position, last 2 clubs, and career peak stats.
  - *Stat MCQ*: Multiple-choice statistical trivia with 4 options.
  - *True/False (Over/Under)*: Predict whether a player or team stat is above or below a given threshold.
  - *Streaks & Rewards*: Answering correctly 2 days in a row earns 1 bonus question for the TikiStata AI agent. Active streaks and personal records are tracked.
- **Gamification (Badges & Trophies)**: Users collect virtual achievement badges and trophies by exploring statistical themes with the AI.

## Pricing & Subscription Plans
- **Free Tier**: Daily usage quota with ads (and rewarded videos to unlock more questions).
- **Captain Subscription**: €1.99/month, 1st month free trial, no commitment. 15 questions/day ad-free (rewarded video required beyond daily quota), up to 5 Q&A turns per thread.
- **Legend Subscription**: €2.99/month, 1st month free trial, no commitment. 30 questions/day ad-free (rewarded video required beyond daily quota), up to 7 Q&A turns per thread.
- **One-Shot Question Pack**: €0.99 for 15 additional consumable questions (one-time purchase).

# Splitou - AI Bill Splitting & Group Expense App

## About Splitou
**Splitou** is an AI-powered bill-splitting and group expense mobile application (iOS and Android, package `app.splitou`) developed by **Eljie Tech** (Lucas JULLIA EI), available in **7 languages** (French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Dutch).
It combines two core modes:
1. **One-Shot Bill Splitting (Restaurants, Bars, Outings)**: The person who paid photographs the receipt; AI (Google Vertex AI Gemini) extracts the venue, items, quantities, prices, and discounts, and checks that the item sum matches the total paid. A live shared session (QR code + web link `https://splitou-app.web.app/s/{id}`) is generated instantly so friends can tick what they had in real time from their mobile or desktop browser without installing an app or creating an account, and pay back via Wero, Lydia, Revolut, PayPal, bank transfer/IBAN, or cash.
2. **Trips & Groups Mode (Vacations, Flatshares, Shared Expenses)**: Long-term collaborative expense tracking with multi-currency support, 4 ultra-flexible split modes (*Equal*, *Shares/weights*, *Exact amounts*, *Item-by-item*), live collaborative editing, optimal debt settlement algorithm, interactive statistics, and unlockable trophies.

## Key Features
- **AI Receipt Scanning (Vertex AI Gemini)**: Venue, items, quantities, prices, and discounts extracted in seconds, with automatic total verification before sharing.
- **Zero-Install Live Guest Webapp**: Friends join via QR code or link in their browser (available in 7 languages) with no app download or account creation. Live sync prevents two guests from claiming the same item inconsistently and supports splitting shared items (e.g., a bottle).
- **One-Tap Repayment**: Supports host payout details (Wero, Lydia, Revolut, PayPal, bank transfer/IBAN, or cash); the host tracks who has paid in real time.
- **Trips & Groups Mode with Live Collaborative Editing**: Create groups via link or QR code, add expenses by AI scan or manually, split equally / by shares / by exact amounts / item-by-item, and edit itemized expenses collaboratively in real time with presence detection (`isViewing`) and atomic revision locking.
- **Smart Debt Simplification**: Financial balance algorithm computing the minimum number of transfers needed to settle all group debts.
- **Detailed Statistics & 16 Lifetime Trophies**:
  - Category Donut charts (food, drinks, groceries, transport, lodging, activities, shopping), "who paid vs who consumed" comparison, daily spending evolution, record day, and interactive KPI tiles with detailed popovers.
  - **16 Trophies & Badges** (10 trip awards such as *Group Banker*, *Foodie*, *Happy-Hour King*, *Groceries Chief*, *Road Captain*, *Adventurer*, *Shopaholic*, *Receipt Hunter*, *Budget Master*, *Biggest Bill*, plus 6 solo & scan badges) permanently preserved for life in the user's profile even if a trip is later deleted.
- **Available in 7 Languages**: French, English, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Dutch.

## Pricing & Plans
- **Free Tier**: Monthly quota of free AI receipt scans (recharged on the 1st of each month, with the option to unlock additional free scans anytime without waiting by watching a short rewarded video ad), unlimited QR code sharing, and full Trips & Groups mode included, with discreet ads (never shown on the guest repayment page).
- **Vacation Pass (Pass Vacances — €2.99 one-time payment)**: 30 consecutive days of full Splitou Premium access with **no auto-renewal** and no recurring charges.
- **Splitou Premium (€1.99/month or €14.99/year)**: Auto-renewing subscription with no commitment (cancel anytime). Unlocks:
  - Complete removal of all ads across the app
  - Unlimited AI receipt scans (subject to fair personal use)
  - Automatic multi-currency conversion with live exchange rates
  - Full export of expenses and group accounts to printable PDF and CSV (Excel) spreadsheets

## Privacy & Security
Receipt photos are never stored after AI reading, shared bills are deleted automatically after 90 days, and data is hosted in the European Union (Google Cloud / Firebase, `europe-west1`), in full compliance with GDPR.
